name: Cabinet
dimensions: Height 122.5 cm; Length 74.5 cm; Depth 43.5 cm
summary: Cabinet with an upper display section and a lower storage section. It was a piece of furniture in the living room of a well-to-do scholar. Precious archaic bronzes would have been displayed on the upper section, whereas scrolls of painting or calligraphy would have been stored in the lower section.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
